title: Great Location Escape, Pool & Gym Access, Sleeps 4
description:
Life of the Party, Unit #418

The space
Steps from the heart of Music City, this modern perch ensures an amusing and memorable trip! Spend your days exploring downtown's vibrant music, art, and cultural scene. Within walking distance, you'll discover the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum, Music City Center, Ascend Amphitheater, the Frist Art Museum, Nashville Children's Theatre, and multiple parks. Rest assured that there is no lack of delicious dining and vibrant shopping opportunities around Nashville. 

Back at your stay, get comfortable amidst the steady stream of sunlight that shines into the spacious main living area. When you aren't indulging in the local food scene, prepare tasty treats in the well-equipped kitchen, complete with stainless steel appliances and gleaming countertops. When it's time to eat, dining for two will come effortlessly at the wooden dining table.

The spacious bedroom has been decorated to your satisfaction with its high-quality linens, large smart TV, and quick balcony access. Additional sleeping arrangements can be found on the living room sofa bed. A private washer/dryer, central air-conditioning, and internet round out the condo's interior amenities. 

During your stay, be sure to utilize the condo's shared grilling area, cabana, pool, firepit, and fitness center.

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.
